name: headless-media-sdk
description: Headless media SDK ecosystem: framework-agnostic core, thin platform wrappers, pure-UI component libraries, and one app that wires them together.

scripts.build:libs: tsc -b packages/media-core packages/media-react packages/media-native packages/media-ui-react packages/media-ui-native
scripts.build:docs: npm run build --workspace docs/sdk && npm run build --workspace docs/components
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build:app && npm run build:docs
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --force packages/media-core packages/media-react packages/media-native packages/media-ui-react packages/media-ui-native
scripts.verify: npm run check:boundaries && npm run build:libs && npm test
